meta.retention_definition: lowT_retention = lowT_discharge.capacity_ah / 1C_discharge.capacity_ah (same params, same mode); mechanically computed and written to bridge/derived_*.json
meta.safety_defaults_note: task text silent on safety metrics; protocol-default safety exam applied: 4C charge at 45C, lumped thermal + plating; T_max_K <= 333.15 K (60 C) and plated=false
meta.stage1_note: molecular-level layer not engaged at start_stage=3; protocol-default elimination lines pre-registered in case of material-design escalation
meta.start_stage_basis: no new materials/additives/electrolyte design named in task text -> architecture/formulation optimization scope -> start_stage 3 (SKILL 0.2 rule)

objective_breakdown: stage2: lowT_retention>=0.95 (lowT_discharge cap / 1C cap), energy_density_wh_kg>=327.18, energy_density_wh_l>=880 (calc-energy, 1C DFN); stage3 defaults (task silent on safety): T_max_K<=333.15 at 4C charge 45C lumped, plated=false. Central Pareto tension: thick/low-porosity electrodes raise ED but hurt -20C kinetics; size-up from parameter dump (Chen2020 stack 0.423 kg/m2, 200.8 um, 5 Ah) suggests ED/volumetric pass with margin at baseline; retention is the expected binding constraint.
candidate_strategy: R1 Chen2020 baseline full characterization + opening ceiling assessment (best-possible architecture+formulation of NMC811/graphite vs objective; ceiling breach -> escalate to system-switch candidate OKane2022 SiOx). R2+: retention levers (electrolyte sigma/D/t+ formulation boosts, particle radius reduction, thinning only if needed); ED/volumetric levers (thin CC 8/6 um, porosity reduction, separator thinning); every evaluated round passes the 4C/45C plating exam.
budget_allocation: ~12 rounds: R1 baseline+ceiling; 3-4 retention levers; 2-3 ED/volumetric; 2-3 joint tuning; 1-2 safety confirmation + DFN finals. System-switch round inserted on escalation trigger (re-baselines retention; OKane2022 electrolyte has real Arrhenius T-dependence).
risk_and_fallback: 1) retention may be kinetics-limited (j0 Ea dominates at -20C) -> combine transport boosts with particle-radius reduction, verify in R2 before spending rounds; 2) Chen2020 electrolyte conductivity is T-independent (measured) -> annotate artifact, re-validate final design on OKane2022 as robustness check; 3) ED_vol binding -> low-porosity architecture helps both ED metrics (no conflict); 4) DFN stiffness at 253 K -> SPMe fallback annotated; 5) three-strike rule -> layer-by-layer questioning before negative close.

detail: start_stage=3: this case starts at Stage 3 (cell design); no molecular funnel runs. Materials use system baseline. Chosen base: Chen2020 — matching basis: task text names no electrode system -> anchor-table default Chen2020 (SKILL 1.5); discriminant verified by parameter dump (work/dump_params.py): NMC811/graphite teaching parameterization (negative density 1657 kg/m3, negative max conc 33133 mol/m3, positive 63104; cell geometry pos 75.6/neg 85.2 um, sep 12 um, CC 16/12 um, 5 Ah nominal, area 0.1027 m2). props source: baseline (literature values inside Chen2020 set). Ceiling assessment (ceiling_escalation ON, executed at baseline): best-possible Chen2020 architecture+formulation = CC 8/6 um + separator 10 um + anode porosity 0.30 + electrolyte sigma/t+/D boost + particles 4/3 um -> ED_mass ceiling ~490 Wh/kg (>327.18), ED_vol ceiling ~900 Wh/L (>880), lowT retention ~99% (note: Chen2020 electrolyte conductivity function is T-independent, measured 0.9487 S/m at both 298/253 K — retention ceiling is optimistic; artifact annotated). Objective below ceiling -> no material-design escalation triggered; remain in architecture/formulation space. Binding risk identified: 4C/45C plating (baseline anode_potential_v min -0.438 V -> plated) and ED_vol 844.45 < 880.
